completion_requirements: Every included node is online_verified before total migration completion is claimed.
Blocked nodes first receive a registered resource owner and protocol path.
All user mutations use generated commands and owner re-query.
No owner truth is stored in browser local state or Android.
Browser and cookie scope remain excluded.
Duplicate legacy implementations are physically retired after dependency and online proof.
